title: Peruvian 'face peeler' alien attacks
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Peruvian 'face peeler' alien attacks, about 2023 at San Antonio de Pintoyaku, Alto Nanay, Peruvian Amazon, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: San Antonio de Pintoyaku, Alto Nanay, Peruvian Amazon

tellings.quote: they were being attacked by aliens. Some said aliens, others said pelacaras which which translates to face peelers.

and basically what they were encountering was the way that these incursions would begin was it'd be night time, always at night time, always after dark. And they would see like two mini flying saucers hovering in the air,
tellings.difference: Describes how the raids began: at night, with two mini flying saucers hovering, and armored attackers on hoverboards. Credits Doug.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the 2023 night-time attacks on villagers in San Antonio de Pintoyaku in the Alto Nanay that were blamed on aliens or 'face peelers'.

as_told.title: Armored assailants on hoverboards raid villages in the Peruvian Amazon
as_told.place_text: San Antonio de Pintuyacu, Alto Nanay region, Amazon, Peru

related.note: This is the same 2023 Pintoyaku attacks as telling 8, but the police put them down to river miners with jetpacks rather than aliens.

plain: Tim Alberino says that around 2023, villagers in San Antonio de Pintoyaku, a community in the Alto Nanay area of the Peruvian Amazon, reported being attacked by aliens, or by what some of them called "pelacaras," meaning face peelers. Passing on what a man named Doug told him, Alberino says the raids always started after dark: two small flying saucers would hover in the air, and then attackers in armor would arrive on hoverboards. If true, it would be a rare report of non-human beings physically attacking people.
